resolvedCoverage.notes: Four exact public-domain/CC0 originals now cover the fixed terminal exterior together: local QuallaPedroXing2012plaza frontage, JimHenderson2013tower detail, ScuBa2023platform-side roof/tower and PierreBlaché2019river frontage under his explicit primaryCC0dedication. Current model preserves the six deep elliptical ferry arches, five gabled plaza bays, waiting-room mass, copper roof hierarchy, reconstructed clocktower, skylights, pier piles and five canopied gangway approaches. Existing physical clock faces, cornices and tower craft match their close references. Rooftop relief/sculpture/sign lettering, pile engineering, hidden roof joins and exact landing dimensions are simplified medium-fi interpretations. Warm sunrise illumination is excluded from material color judgment. Native map/public-USGSground, original datum and bounded placement remain unchanged; marine returns do not establish tide or seabed. Whole fixed exterior accepted at approximate medium-fi scope, with no claim of a measured restoration or navigable interior.
